brand_identity.name: DOMVUS
brand_identity.design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast (Archetype 4). Objective, rigid, and strictly functional.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Use exact fonts below. Never use Inter for headings. Ensure high legibility for dense numbers.

headings.usage: H1-H4, KPIs, Hero numbers, Section titles.

body.usage: Data tables, descriptions, forms, ledgers, financial figures.
body.features: MUST use 'font-tabular-nums' for all currency and numeric columns.

colors.theme_preference: Light theme is primary. Deep contrast dark mode provided as secondary. Avoid generic purples or tech gradients.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px solid borders (border-border) for cards and grids. Do NOT use soft shadows for standard dashboard cards.
visual_enhancers.radius: Use sharp, professional corners: rounded-md (6px) or rounded-sm (4px). Avoid fully rounded pill shapes unless it's a small status badge.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimalist flat design. Rely on borders to separate elements. Only use shadow-sm on interactive hover states, dropdowns, and modals.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use for sticky headers if content scrolls underneath (e.g., backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80). Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on data surfaces.

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components but strip away default Vercel vibes. Implement dense, technical configurations.
components.sidebar: Grouped layout: Management, Finance, Operations, Documents, Administration. Use a crisp background (bg-card or bg-slate-50) with a 1px right border. Use Lucide-react icons (size 18).
components.data_tables: CRITICAL: High information density. Use py-2 px-3 padding for table cells. text-sm text. Align all financial columns to the right. Use font-tabular-nums for monetary values. Subtle border-b on rows.
components.status_badges: Professional, low-saturation backgrounds with high-contrast text. E.g., Pago: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800. Pendente: bg-amber-100 text-amber-800. rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold.
components.kpi_cards: Bento-style metrics. Top label text-sm text-muted-foreground. Metric value: Manrope font-bold text-3xl. Include small trend indicator (e.g., +2.5% this month) in semantic colors.
components.empty_states: Must be useful. Center aligned inside a bordered container. Include a Lucide icon (stroke-width 1.5, text-muted-foreground), a clear brief title, and a primary action button.
components.charts: Use Recharts or Shadcn Charts. Stick to corporate colors (Brand Slate, Emerald, Rose). No neon glowing lines. Keep axes clean and legible.

layouts.grids: Follow the 'High Density Grid' protocol. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 for KPI summaries. Main charts take col-span-2 or col-span-3.
layouts.spacing: Maintain rigid hierarchy. gap-4 or gap-6 for dashboard items. Ensure internal padding of cards is p-5 or p-6 to prevent text collision.

login_background.description: Modern architecture's glass facade. Use for the login/auth split-screen background. Apply a heavy overlay (bg-slate-900/60) so it feels corporate and premium.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: NO 'AI slop' aesthetics. Absolutely NO purple-on-white gradients, glowing neon dropshadows, or rounded bubbly buttons. Keep it strictly Swiss, flat, and professional.
LANGUAGE: The entire UI must be in European Portuguese as specified in the prompt (e.g., Condomínios, Frações, Condóminos, Relatórios).
CURRENCY: Format all monetary values as EUR (€) in Portuguese standard (e.g., 1.250,00 €).
DATES: Format all dates in Portuguese standard (DD/MM/YYYY).
ACCESSIBILITY & CONTRAST: Ensure text over any background (especially status badges) meets WCAG AA contrast. Never use gray-on-gray unreadable text.
INTERACTIVITY: All buttons and list items must have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-muted).
TESTING: Every single interactive element and major data block MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-finance').
ALIGNMENT: Do NOT center-align data tables or forms. Left-align text, right-align numbers. Optical alignment is key.
